reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：主播准入与资质 → 直播间与推流 → 直播实时弹幕 → 礼物、舰队与醒目留言 → 连麦与互动连屏 → 回放与回放转投稿。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: Anchor Onboarding → Live Rooms and Streaming → Live Danmaku → Gifts, Guards and Super Chat → Co-host and Multi-guest → Replays and Promote to Video. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
